title: [AUG-189] Post-100% processing indicator: tick-sweep ring and server stage label on the transcription screen
why_we_need_this: Rodion's feedback (Feature Request 2, @docs/feedback/2026-11-rodion-feedback.md): once the countdown ring reaches 00:00:00 / 100% the EXTERMINATUS INITIATED screen looks frozen, although the server still merges, checks the text, suggests corrections and saves for 30 s to 4 min (up to ~8 min with the local model budgets). Research AUG-177 measured it on real sessions (255 s call: ring at zero at 34 s, done at 69 s) and traced the stages. Agreed decisions (AUG-177, 2026-11-04): Variant B "Tick sweep" from @docs/mockups/AUG-177/processing-spinner.html, indicator + named stage label from the server, the ring center keeps 00:00:00 / 100%, the stage text lives under the ring, the red banner stays. Without this users cancel or restart jobs that are about to finish.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Server: `SessionMetadata` gets an optional `processingStage: 'cleaning' | 'checking' | 'correcting' | 'saving'` (@server/src/types.ts, mirrored in the client session type). `runTranscription` and `runDualTranscription` (@server/src/routes/sessions.ts) write `cleaning` right after whisper returns, `runSemanticPass` (@server/src/services/semanticCheck.ts) writes `checking` before perplexity scoring and `correcting` before local or Groq corrections, the route writes `saving` before `renderTranscript`. The same `updateSession` call that sets `completed` or `failed` clears the field; retranscribe and cancel clear it too.
- [ ] Client: while `status === 'transcribing'` and either the ring is zeroed or `processingStage` is set, the 60 ticks run the tick-sweep animation from mockup Variant B (sweep 2.4 s linear infinite, per-tick delay i × 40 ms, zeroed red palette); the center keeps "remaining / 00:00:00 / 100%" and the red EXTERMINATUS INITIATED banner stays. A set `processingStage` forces the zeroed state even if the ETA has not run out (whisper is done, the ETA was a guess).
- [ ] Client: under the ring, where the «Завершение в HH:MM» bar is removed at zero, a `.chrono-info-bar` reads "Still working — <stage> · you can leave this page" with the stage mapped cleaning → "cleaning up", checking → "checking the text", correcting → "suggesting fixes", saving → "saving", missing or unknown → "finishing". Three 4×4 px square blinkers (not circles) sit under the text as in Variant B. User words only: no method names, timings, model names or percentages beyond the existing 100%.
- [ ] Reduced motion: under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the sweep and the blinkers are static (extend the existing block in @client/src/App.css near the `.chrono-*` reduced-motion rules); the stage text and the Elapsed counter keep updating. 0 border-radius everywhere except the ring circles and the existing 6 px dots.
- [ ] Both themes render per the mockup tokens (light and dark zeroed palette); the Cancel and Restart controls keep working during post-processing.
- [ ] Verification: `npm run build` in client and `npm run build` (tsc) in server pass, existing tests pass (`gpuBackend.test.ts`, `config.test.ts`, `semanticCheck.test.ts`); manual check on Windows with the local model and corrections on, on a ≥ 4 min recording: the sweep runs after zero and at least two different stage labels appear before the transcript opens; macOS check noted as pending in a release build.
- [ ] project-context updated: frontend-design (Chronometer Ring section: zeroed-state indicator, stage label rule, reduced-motion fallback) and transcription (processingStage field, which stage is written where, cleared on completion); roadmap M2 line marks the impl.
important_constraints: Mockup and decisions: @docs/mockups/AUG-177/processing-spinner.html, Variant B (tick sweep); decisions D1 = B, D2 = indicator + stage label, D3 = keep 00:00:00 in the center (stage under the ring), D4 = keep the red banner. Research and file:line map of the post-100% stages: card AUG-177. Stage labels are user words only (project rule «no diagnostics in user UI»). Platform: shared client/server paths, no platform branches expected; verify Windows, note macOS as pending. Commit straight to master (project rule). Out of scope: making the ETA itself honest (whisper-only perf ratio) — separate follow-up if wanted (AUG-177 decision D5). Depends on: AUG-177-z4864m. Roadmap: M2 Live session control.
